properties.name: Grand Banks of Newfoundland
properties.why: The primary maritime domain awareness area for Newfoundland and Labrador: the Jeanne d'Arc Basin oil installations, the Grand Banks fishing grounds, and the transatlantic approaches to St. John's all fall inside it.
properties.installations: Hibernia, Hebron, Terra Nova, White Rose (see agents/infrastructure.py)
properties.note: Sized to fit inside a single Sentinel-1 IW swath (250 km); 3.5 deg of longitude here is ~265 km.
